name: What happens to my sink during quartz countertop installation?

mainEntity.name: What happens to my sink during quartz countertop installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: During quartz countertop installation, your existing sink will need to be disconnected and removed. For your new quartz, we will cut a precise opening to accommodate your chosen sink. Most homeowners opt for an undermount sink with quartz, which is installed directly to the underside of the countertop for a seamless look. Our team will ensure the sink cutout is accurate and the sink is properly mounted and sealed. This process requires specialized tools and expertise to ensure a watertight and durable seal, which is a critical step for preventing future issues. We recommend coordinating plumbing services for reconnection post-installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Your existing sink is removed; a precise cutout is made in the new quartz for your chosen sink, usually an undermount. We ensure accurate cutting and proper, watertight sealing for durability.
